task: Phase 2 task 011: Level-2 peek-strip progressive disclosure for SegmentRenderMonitor

frontend/src/components/progress/Segment.summary: New shared block-encoding primitive extracted out of SegmentRenderMonitor.tsx so the full field (Level 3) and the new peek strip (Level 2) render the same char-weighted block encoding at two heights instead of shipping a second implementation. Owns (moved here as canonical source, re-exported from SegmentRenderMonitor.tsx for back-compat): the SegmentRenderPhase/SegmentRenderMonitorSegment types, PHASE_LABEL, useReducedMotion (M3 gate), the per-segment blockStyle fill, and a new 'SegmentBlockRow' component (props: segments, height, ariaLabel, optional onBlockClick). Does not own the aggregate bar, accessible table, popover, or milestone aria-live region — those stay SegmentRenderMonitor-only concerns.

10-60 segment full-field branch now delegates to <SegmentBlockRow height={10} onBlockClick={openPopoverFor} /> instead of an inline block-mapping JSX block (behavior unchanged, verified by the full existing test suite still passing). Exports FULL_STRIP_MIN (was module-private) so ActivityPage's peek-strip eligibility gate reuses the same 'is there a full field worth expanding into' threshold instead of a second hardcoded 10. Re-exports SegmentRenderPhase/SegmentRenderMonitorSegment from SegmentBlockRow.tsx (moved there) for back-compat with existing importers/tests.

New Level-2 component: a condensed (5px) SegmentBlockRow wrapped in one whole-strip 'Expand' button plus a separate 'Dismiss' button (props: segments, activeCount, onExpand, onDismiss). Purely presentational/controlled — no internal dismiss/expand state, no localStorage access; the caller (ActivityPage) owns all state.

frontend/src/utils/segmentPeekStripState.summary: Per-job-id localStorage dismissal persistence for the peek strip ('studio-peek-strip-dismissed:<jobId>'), matching railState.ts's try/catch get/set pattern (the closest existing localStorage-preference convention in this codebase). Deliberately not reactive via useSyncExternalStore (single consumer: ActivityPage).

frontend/src/pages/Activity/ActivityPage.summary: Wires the peek-strip/full-field progressive-disclosure ladder for the dev-gated active-job segment monitor. New derived state: renderingCount (segments with phase 'rendering'), failedCount, monitorEligible (devMode && activeJob && total >= FULL_STRIP_MIN), peekEligible (monitorEligible && renderingCount >= 2). Behavior change (flagged): previously the full SegmentRenderMonitor field rendered unconditionally whenever devMode+activeJob (task 008/010); now the peek strip renders instead once renderingCount >= 2, and only expands to the full field on click (or directly, unchanged, when renderingCount < 2 -- since there's no useful 'strip' rung below that threshold). Dismiss persists per job id via segmentPeekStripState.ts but is overridden whenever failedCount > 0 (a failure can never be dismissed away), satisfying the 'failure re-surfaces even after a prior dismiss' requirement. Expand/dismiss/monitor-eligibility state resets when the active job id changes.

flow_impact: Introduces the previously-missing Level 2 rung (design-docs/plans/active/parallel-segment-rendering/10-phase2-render-monitor.md 'Placement') between the plain default bar and the always-static-until-010 full block field: a narrow auto-appearing condensed strip that expands inline (no navigation/modal) into the existing SegmentRenderMonitor field. No change to the M1-M3 aggregate/render contract, task 009's milestone aria-live region, or task 010's popover/keyboard interaction -- all covered by the full existing SegmentRenderMonitor test suite passing unmodified alongside the new SegmentBlockRow/SegmentPeekStrip/ActivityPage peek-strip tests.
